queries.query: LLM network operations failures hallucination "network configuration" "large language model"
queries.rationale: Locate empirical reports and analyses of LLM-produced incorrect or unsafe NetOps artifacts (hallucinations, incorrect syntax/semantics, harmful changes).

queries.query: intent-based networking "natural language" to configuration translation "large language model"
queries.rationale: Survey work on mapping operator intent (NL) to device/router/switch config—relevant to task framing and operational realism.
Find architectures combining generation, deterministic validators, and automated repair loops applied to NetOps.

queries.query: formal verification network configurations VeriFlow NetKAT Header Space Analysis change validation
queries.rationale: Collect classic and modern deterministic verification/analysis tools and methods for validating network changes (to use as gold-standard validators or comparison baselines).
Identify existing benchmark suites, datasets, and evaluation practices for AIOps/NetOps and LLM evaluations to assess benchmark validity and gaps.

queries.query: LLM prompt sensitivity "network configuration" robustness "prompt engineering"
queries.rationale: Find studies on prompt dependence and sensitivity relevant to reproducibility and internal validity of NetOps LLM outputs.

queries.rationale: Locate methods for deriving calibrated confidence/uncertainty from LLMs to support safe NetOps decisions or gating by validators.

queries.rationale: Survey use of retrieval from topology/docs/ACLs to ground generation and reduce hallucination in config synthesis.

queries.rationale: Search for applications or analyses of RLHF or constrained-output training to reduce unsafe or incorrect NetOps outputs.
Find adversarial or stress-testing techniques applied to LLMs producing domain-specific config to understand failure modes.

queries.rationale: Gather operational mitigations (canarying, staged rollouts, shadow testing, circuit breakers) that complement model-side mitigations.

queries.rationale: Locate rigorous experimental designs for evaluating autonomous/assisted systems in operational domains (paired designs, A/B, fault-injection).

queries.rationale: Find publicly-available NetOps datasets and simulation environments usable for reproducible experiments and validators.
Survey general LLM failure-mode taxonomies to adapt to NetOps-specific categorization and mitigation mapping.

queries.query: agentic AI "autonomous" network operations safety "orchestration" "LLM agent"
queries.rationale: Locate literature on agentic systems, orchestration frameworks, and safety considerations when LLM agents perform operational tasks.

queries.query: external validity benchmarks simulation vs production "network" "benchmark validity"
queries.rationale: Search meta-analyses and critiques on benchmark realism, simulation-to-deployment gaps, and how evaluation choices affect validity.
Identify closest applied studies performing automated repair of configs or fix-generation to assess novelty gaps.

inclusion_criteria: Peer-reviewed conference or journal papers, and arXiv preprints with verifiable authorship and metadata.
Public datasets, code repositories, and tools referenced in papers or hosted on stable archives (GitHub, Zenodo, institutional pages).
Works addressing LLMs, generative models, or agentic systems applied to network configuration, change planning, validation, or repair.
Studies of verification/formal methods for network configurations (classical and modern) to serve as validators or baselines.
Papers on evaluation methodology, benchmark construction, or threats-to-validity relevant to operational realism.
Operator/industry technical whitepapers or RFCs that describe operational practice and mitigation techniques (when technical and citable).
Literature from ~2018–2026 for LLM-specific methods, with inclusion of seminal pre-2018 works for network verification and foundations.
exclusion_criteria: Non-technical marketing material, product pages, or unverifiable blog posts lacking authorship/date/venue unless they provide unique, citable operator practice (use sparingly).
Proprietary internal reports or datasets not publicly accessible.
Papers unrelated to NetOps or without clear implications for network-change correctness, safety, or validation.
Benchmarks that only test generic language knowledge (factual Q&A) without operational/NetOps task grounding.
date_rationale: Focus primarily on 2018–2026 because transformer/LLM advances and recent LLM-NetOps work emerged post-2018; however include foundational pre-2018 research (e.g., NetKAT, VeriFlow, Header Space) for verification baselines and conceptual grounding.
